Gate G0_DATA: Pool graph populated (metric Eligible pools, threshold > 0, action Load/refresh pool state)
Gate G1_DISCOVERY: Candidates discovered (metric Candidate routes, threshold > 0, action Enable algorithms / relax filters)
Gate G2_BUDGET: Candidate count within runtime budget (metric Candidates vs budget, threshold <= Config budget, action Increase pruning or budget)
Gate G3_FINANCING: Selected financing enabled (metric Mode enabled, threshold YES, action Enable mode or switch mode)
Gate G4_ECON: At least one positive selected route (metric Viable routes, threshold > 0, action Review EV/gas/liquidity/financing)
Gate G5_LATENCY: Enabled algorithm fits CPU proxy (metric Algorithms fit, threshold > 0, action Use subgraph/pruning/incremental pass)
Gate G6_EXECUTION: Default control is SHADOW (metric Execution mode, threshold canonical mode, action Return to SHADOW for research enumeration)
